title: Power shutoffs during high wind and low humidity
summary: The power company shuts off power when wind gusts reach 45 miles per hour or more and humidity is below 45 percent, a disability commission meeting heard, and people using powered medical equipment were urged to fill out a medical needs form. A council member repeated the shutoff rule when a visiting delegation asked who controls power as Lahaina recovers.

timeline.text: A council member said the power company shuts off power when wind is over 45 miles per hour and humidity is under 45 percent.
People who rely on powered medical equipment were urged to fill out a medical needs form.
The company said shutoffs depend on drought, wind gusts of 45 miles per hour or more, and humidity below 45%.
